Studies.title: Higher Vocational Certificate in Software Development
Studies.description: Eszterházy Károly Catholic University – Correspondence Program

ModalContent: Focused on practical software development skills alongside full-time work, which significantly improved my problem-solving and time management abilities.
Worked with multiple programming languages and paradigms, including object-oriented design and basic software architecture principles.
Gained experience in backend development, databases, and building small scale applications.
The correspondence format required a high level of self-discipline and independent learning.

Studies.title: BSc in Computer Science (incomplete)
Studies.description: Eszterházy Károly Catholic University – Full-time Program

ModalContent: Built a strong theoretical foundation in computer science, including algorithms, data structures, and system fundamentals.
Learned low-level programming concepts and gained insight into how software interacts with hardware.
Although I did not complete the degree, this period played a key role in shaping my technical thinking.
Transitioned from theory-heavy education to a more practical, hands-on development path.

Studies.title: High School Diploma
Studies.description: János Vak Bottyán Catholic Technical and Economics Secondary School

ModalContent: Studied basic IT and English, which sparked my initial interest in programming and technology.
Developed early analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
This period laid the foundation for my later transition into software development.
Working as an application developer primarily with .NET technologies in an enterprise environment.
Acting as a technical lead on a project, responsible for system design decisions and architecture planning.
Collaborating daily in an international team, using English as the primary working language.
Handling unclear or evolving requirements by designing flexible and maintainable solutions.
Contributing to improving development processes and code quality within the team.

Work.title: Volunteer Programming Instructor
Work.description: Dr. Code – Teaching basic programming to students

ModalContent: Taught basic programming concepts to students, focusing on logic, problem-solving, and algorithmic thinking.
Explained complex technical topics in a simple and understandable way.
Developed communication and mentoring skills that I still use in professional environments.
This experience strengthened my understanding of fundamentals by teaching them to others.
